auto-pumping-matching-counts.rationale: Matching runs, palindrome symmetry and the two b boundaries are direct proof witnesses; their decisive facts stay visible.

auto-pumping-arithmetic.rationale: The consecutive-square gap and lost one-character lead directly explain the contradictions; a metaphor would duplicate these witnesses.

auto-pumping-closure-limits.rationale: Intersection filtering and the pumpable counterexample are short direct constructions; an analogy would add no proof value.

auto-minimise-equivalence.rationale: Empty and one-symbol suffixes directly demonstrate future-behaviour equivalence; no additional comparison is required.

auto-minimise-refinement.rationale: The worked transition table, code and partition rounds provide a complete concrete mechanism without a metaphor.

auto-minimise-algorithms.rationale: Block halving and the four-step reversal flow are already visual and concrete; no further comparison is necessary.

auto-myhill-nerode.rationale: Two prefixes completed by the same suffix are the direct theorem witness; an analogy would weaken the distinction between strings and classes.

auto-minimise-applications.rationale: Actual regex-equivalence and lexer uses give practical context; the DFA/NFA boundary needs precise statements rather than a comparison.

auto-regex-backtracking.rationale: Explicit path enumeration and cut positions directly show repeated work; another metaphor would duplicate the code and input example.

auto-regex-growth-outages.rationale: Near-matching inputs and the sourced outage directly supply practical context and growth mechanisms.

auto-regex-automaton-engines.rationale: Active-state merging, cache flushing and concrete unsupported syntax describe the implementation choices directly.

auto-regex-defences.rationale: This is a practical checklist with actual rewrite and atomicity cases; an additional metaphor would not improve decisions.
